Fishing in a closed area.requires: the vessel being where it should not be
Fishing in a closed area.provides: a position-based offence, provable from track data alone

Exceeding quota.requires: landing more than allocated over a season
Exceeding quota.provides: an accounting offence, provable only from landing records

Prohibited gear type.requires: the gear physically aboard or in use
Prohibited gear type.provides: a physical offence, provable only by seeing the gear

Misreporting catch composition.requires: a declaration differing from the actual catch
Misreporting catch composition.provides: a documentary offence, provable only by comparing catch to declaration

Industrial distant-water trawler.provides: mandatory monitoring equipment, observer capacity, high catch volume

Domestic coastal vessel.requires: a national licence and home port
Domestic coastal vessel.provides: regular port calls, moderate monitoring obligations

Artisanal small boat.provides: no monitoring equipment, no observer space, landings outside formal ports

Reefer transhipment vessel.requires: receiving catch at sea from other vessels
Reefer transhipment vessel.provides: never fishes itself, mixes catch from many sources, obscures origin

Satellite vessel monitoring.provides: continuous position, nothing about catch or gear

Onboard observer.requires: space aboard and a trained observer
Onboard observer.provides: direct witness of gear and catch, unavailable on small vessels

Port state inspection.requires: the vessel calling at a controlled port
Port state inspection.provides: physical inspection of hold and gear, nothing about where it fished

Aerial patrol.requires: aircraft on task over the fishing ground
Aerial patrol.provides: visual confirmation of position and visible gear, brief coverage

Position track only.provides: proof of location, no proof of catch or gear

Physical catch inspection.provides: proof of composition and volume, no proof of origin

Observer testimony.provides: proof of gear and practice, contestable

Financial penalty.requires: proven offence and an entity able to pay

Licence suspension.requires: a licence issued by the sanctioning authority
Licence suspension.provides: operational interruption, no reach over foreign-flagged vessels

Vessel forfeiture.requires: grave or repeated offence and jurisdiction over the hull
Vessel forfeiture.provides: termination of the operation, rarely available

_v1_notes.VIOLATION|VESSEL: a reefer never fishes, so closed-area fishing, quota and gear offences are all N for it; misreporting composition is precisely its offence. Misreporting is N for an artisanal boat with no formal declaration to falsify.
_v1_notes.VIOLATION|SURVEILLANCE: quota, gear and composition offences are all N for satellite monitoring, which sees position only. Closed-area fishing is N for port inspection, which says nothing about where it fished. Gear offences are Y for aerial patrol only where gear is visible; quota and composition are N for aerial patrol.
_v1_notes.VIOLATION|EVIDENCE QUALITY: closed-area is provable by track alone but N by catch inspection and N by observer as the decisive evidence. Quota is N for track and N for observer. Gear is N for track. Composition is N for track.
_v1_notes.VESSEL|SURVEILLANCE: an artisanal boat carries no transponder, has no observer space, and lands outside controlled ports, so only aerial patrol reaches it. A coastal vessel is N for onboard observers. A reefer is N for aerial patrol as a meaningful measure.
_v1_notes.VESSEL|EVIDENCE QUALITY: a coastal vessel is N for observer testimony. An artisanal boat is N for position track and N for observer testimony.
_v1_notes.VESSEL|SANCTION: licence suspension is N for a distant-water trawler and a reefer where the licence is issued by another state.
_v1_notes.SURVEILLANCE|EVIDENCE QUALITY: satellite monitoring yields position only, so catch inspection and observer testimony are N. Observers yield testimony and catch observation but not position track. Port inspection yields catch but not track or testimony. Aerial patrol yields position but not catch or testimony.
_v1_notes.EVIDENCE QUALITY|SANCTION: no usable evidence supports a warning at most; penalty, suspension and forfeiture are all N.
